# BOOSTER brand files

**The mark is generated by ChatGPT**: a syringe that is also a rocket, in cream with one gold accent on the green `#0C5449` tile. Nobody draws it and nobody edits the mark's geometry; the PNGs here are the mark.

| File | Use |
|---|---|
| `booster-avatar-1024.png` | Full-size mark |
| `booster-avatar-512.png` | Project avatar, Open Graph base |
| `booster-avatar-256.png` | Site header and hero, apple-touch-icon, GitLab avatar (under 200 KiB) |
| `favicon-64.png`, `favicon-32.png`, `favicon-16.png`, `favicon.ico` | Favicons |
| `booster-board.png` | The 11-panel brand board: lockups, palette (green `#0C5449`, gold `#FFCC33`, cream), type, favicons, do and don't |

Do not redraw or edit the mark. If a vector is ever needed, trace the PNG with vtracer or potrace.
